title: Ragtime repertoire and Tiger Rag with Jack Carey
summary: Rags played in those days (Maple Leaf, Panama, High Society) and Jack Carey's band being first to sing Tiger Rag.

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom
story.community_name: What we played: tunes and repertoire in the early days

blocks.x: I see. So, did they feature, around that time, did they feature any tunes like Maple Leaf Rag or Frog Leg Rag where you were?
Yeah, Maple Leaf was the famous, but I don't know, but Frog Legs. Climax. Climax. They played there. And this, what's that about the leaf you call it, Silver Leaf.
Silver Leaf Rag. Yeah. Rose Leaf I've heard out too. Well, they had a Silver Leaf too.
And the other thing was out then in them days, Panama Rag. Mm-hmm. Panama Rag, we played that. High Society, we played all them kind of numbers. That's when you were first getting started.
Yeah. Awesome. When did they start playing Make Me a Pallet on the floor? Oh, that was before my time.
But I played it, but they started that before my day. Oh, yeah.
What about Tiger Rag? When did they start playing that?

Well, I'm gonna tell her, I got used to Tiger Rag right there with Jack Kerr in New Orleans. We the first one started singing Tiger Rag. Jack Kerr band. First band started singing it, Hold That Tiger. Yeah.
Well they used to sing something else about Jack Kerr in there too, didn't they?
Well yeah, Jack Kerr had a daughter on the water selling pork chops too for a quarter. Yeah.
Yeah, well that fits right in. That's a melody that fits in.
